title: DeepCool PN750M 750W 80 Plus Gold Full-Modular ATX 3.1 Power Supply

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Power your next-generation gaming PC or workstation with the DeepCool PN750M 750W Power Supply, offering exceptional energy efficiency, future-ready compatibility, and modular flexibility. Certified with 80 PLUS Gold, it provides up to 90% efficiency, reducing heat and power consumption while ensuring consistent performance.

The PN750M fully complies with ATX 3.1 and PCIe 5.0 standards and includes a native 12VHPWR connector, making it ideal for powering modern graphics cards like the NVIDIA RTX 40 Series. Its full-modular cable design allows for clean and optimized cable management, improving airflow and simplifying installation.

With high-quality components, including a Fluid Dynamic Bearing (FDB) 120mm fan, the PN750M ensures long-lasting, quiet, and stable operation under any load.


The DeepCool PN750M 750W 80 Plus Gold Full-Modular ATX 3.1 Power Supply is a premium, high-efficiency PSU built to support modern gaming PCs, professional editing setups, and high-performance workstations. Featuring the latest ATX 3.1 power standard, it ensures maximum compatibility with next-generation GPUs through its native 12V-2×6 (16-pin) PCIe connector, providing superior power stability even under extreme loads.


With 80 Plus Gold certification, the PN750M ensures high energy efficiency, reduced heat output, and improved long-term performance. Its advanced Full Bridge LLC + DC-to-DC architecture guarantees steady voltage regulation, making it ideal for high-end CPUs, GPUs, and multitasking-intensive systems.


The full-modular cable design allows you to use only the cables required for your build, improving airflow and enabling clean cable management. A durable and quiet 120mm Hydro Bearing fan delivers optimized cooling with low noise levels.


For safety and reliability, the PSU includes a full set of protections: OCP, OVP, UVP, SCP, OPP, and OTP. Backed by a 10-year warranty, the DeepCool PN750M offers long-lasting performance and peace of mind for PC builders in Bangladesh seeking a top-tier power solution.
